account: It is day 0, ten o'clock, and I have arrived at the plaza for my scheduled market walk. Three townsfolk are nearby; I have not yet spoken to them or learned any town news. Earlier, three other townsfolk were outside town hall. I do not know whether either gathering has any special purpose. The builder is nearby carrying a lantern, but I have seen nothing to explain that or suggest anything unusual. My secretary said there was no correspondence in the appointments chest and no town news yet. Today's appointment book includes lunch at home at noon, town accounts at thirteen, tea with a neighbour in an unspecified east-bank dockside cottage at fifteen, office at sixteen-thirty, and home at nineteen. Neither the secretary nor I could identify the tea host from the book. At my request, the secretary agreed to ask dockside residents and report back before tea. I now see the secretary walking east near the bridge with the book, which may be connected to that errand, although I cannot yet confirm the destination. So far I have no evidence of any unusual event or coordinated activity in town.
